chunks: He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar al-Ji'abi al-Qadhi reported to me, he said: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Ibrahim narrated to me, he said: Muhammad ibn Abu al-Anbar narrated to us, he said: Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Waqid narrated to us, from his father, from Abu Amr ibn al-Ala, from Abdullah ibn Buraidah, from Bashir ibn Ka'b, from Shaddad ibn Aws who said: The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and his family, said:
"There is no god but Allah" fills half of the scale, and "Praise be to Allah" fills it completely.

key_terms.الحمد لله: Al-hamdu lillah - Praise be to God, an expression of gratitude and acknowledgment of divine blessings
key_terms.الميزان: al-Mizan - The Scale, referring to the divine scale on the Day of Judgment that weighs deeds
key_terms.لا إله إلا الله: La ilaha illa Allah - The declaration of divine unity (tawhid), the most fundamental statement of Islamic faith

ai.seo_question: What is the reward of saying La ilaha illa Allah and Al-hamdu lillah according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: The Prophet (SAWW) taught that the declaration of divine unity (la ilaha illa Allah) fills half of the divine scale of deeds, while expressing praise and gratitude to God (al-hamdu lillah) completes the other half. This hadith, narrated through a chain reaching the companion Shaddad ibn Aws, was delivered in the context of encouraging believers to frequently utter these two fundamental phrases of Islamic faith, emphasizing their immense spiritual weight on the Day of Judgment.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 1. He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar al-Ji’abi al-Qad.hi reported to me from Muhammad ibn ‘Ali ibn Ibrahim, who reported from Muhammad ibn Abu al-Ambar, who reported from ‘Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Waqid, from his father, from Abu Amru ibn al-Ala, from Abdullah ibn Buraidah, from Bashir ibn Ka’b, from Shaddad ibn Aws, who said: The Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, said:
"The confirmation of faith by asserting ’there is no god but Allah’ fills half of the scale, and when one expresses praise and gratitude to Allah, the scale is fully supplemented."
